questions.stem: A rectangle has area 84 cm squared and width 7 cm. What is its length?
questions.explanation: Area = length x width. So length = 84 / 7 = 12 cm.

questions.stem: A triangle has a base of 14 cm and a perpendicular height of 9 cm. What is its area?
questions.explanation: Area of a triangle = (1/2) x base x height = (1/2) x 14 x 9 = 63 cm squared.

questions.stem: A right-angled triangle has legs of 5 cm and 12 cm. What is its area?
questions.explanation: For a right-angled triangle, the two legs are the base and height. Area = (1/2) x 5 x 12 = 30 cm squared.

questions.stem: A triangle has an area of 48 cm squared and a base of 16 cm. What is its perpendicular height?
questions.explanation: Area = (1/2) x base x height. So 48 = (1/2) x 16 x h, giving 48 = 8h, so h = 6 cm.

questions.stem: A rectangular garden is 25 m long and 18 m wide. A triangular flower bed occupies one corner with base 6 m and height 4 m. What area of the garden is NOT covered by the flower bed?
questions.explanation: Garden area = 25 x 18 = 450 m squared. Flower bed area = (1/2) x 6 x 4 = 12 m squared. Remaining area = 450 - 12 = 438 m squared.
